subject: MBTA Bus Network Redesign Feedback
overview: The committee met to collect council and public feedback on proposed MBTA bus service cuts and route alterations. The council voted to request an additional public comment period following any revised MBTA plan and moved to submit all resident testimony and petitions to the agency and the state legislative delegation.

items.title: Discussion on Proposed MBTA Bus Network Redesign
items.summary: Councilors and residents voiced significant concerns regarding proposed reductions in bus service, lost direct transit connections, and the elimination of neighborhood routes across Medford Hillside and West Medford.

items.title: Resolution Requesting Second Public Comment Period
items.summary: The council approved a motion requesting that the MBTA hold another public comment period after releasing any revised bus network redesign map proposal.

items.title: Submission of Feedback and Petitions to MBTA and State Delegation
items.summary: The council approved a motion directing that the committee report, received correspondence, and a 1,200-signature resident petition be submitted to both the MBTA and the city's state legislative delegation prior to the July 31 public comment deadline.
